character: A very large resort in south-west Montana built around Lone Peak, whose summit is reached by a tram, with terrain spread across several connected mountains and a vertical of over 4,000 ft. Steep expert terrain sits up high, with groomed intermediate runs lower down.
learning: Reference note: learning terrain is near the Mountain Village base, and lessons run through the resort's ski and ride school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted, page fetches blocked). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (MT-85 S to Four Corners, US-191 S through Gallatin Canyon, then the Big Sky spur road, MT-64, to Mountain Village); not a routing-service result. Gallatin Canyon is slow in storms.
